messages:
Evelyn (People Ops): Quick heads-up: handbook section "Performance reviews & calibration" updated. New items: 1) mandatory manager calibration meetings each mid-year for teams >6 headcount; 2) a defined process for probation extensions and exceptions; 3) an attestation CSV for managers to confirm completions. Read: https://redwood.hr/handbook/perf-calibration. Please run through your teams and submit the calibration ack by Mon 07/13.

Rae (Eng Manager): Thanks. For probation extensions, what's the allowed max duration? Any approval path?

Marcus (People Ops): Good Q. Standard extension is +30 days; we can approve up to +90 days with a People Ops + Director sign-off. Use the "probation_exception" flag in the CSV and include a short rationale. We'll route approvers automatically.

Diego (People Manager): If I already scheduled a peer calibration for 7/14, is that fine or do we need to hit the deadline earlier?

Evelyn (People Ops): The ack timestamp must be by 07/13. If your session is 07/14, submit the ack after the meeting and mark it as late; you'll get a follow-up from People Ops. Ideally reschedule to meet the deadline.

onboarding-bot: Export queued: perf-calib-roster-2491234567.csv -> s3://redwood-ops/exports/2026/07/. ETA ~1m.

Rae (Eng Manager): Can the calibration be combined across org slices (e.g., infra + platform) or should it be team-level?

Marcus (People Ops): For teams with strong overlap, combined calibration is fine if all managers involved attest and list participants. For combined sessions, include a column "combined_groups" in the CSV with manager emails.

Diego (People Manager): Any training for managers on running these calibrations? I want to avoid unconscious bias and keep notes consistent.

Marcus (People Ops): Yes 10-min microtraining "Calibration fundamentals" published on Learn with sample rubrics and note templates: https://learn.redwood.com/courses/calibration-fundamentals. Completing it will pre-fill parts of the attestation form.

Rae (Eng Manager): Uploaded CSV with 9 direct reports and one probation exception. File: s3://redwood-ops/exports/2026/07/rae-calib-2491234567.csv

Evelyn (People Ops): Received. Job ID: JOB-PERF-2491234567. We'll validate the CSV and send back any rows missing manager_id or rationale for exceptions.

Diego (People Manager): FYI: managers who don't submit by the deadline will get an automated reminder and a temporary hold on promotion cycles until cleared.

Rae (Eng Manager): Noted. I'll reschedule my session to 07/12 to be safe. :calendar:
